builders.angle: LITERAL. Work BRIEF-r14's fix list 1 to 6 in order and exactly as written: every item in it was named by both round-11 judges, and CAMBER's merged work is the base you build on, not something to replace. Fix 1 first, because both judges put it first: a kind gets its own vantage the way it has its own subject, and MADDER's branch (ui/r11-vary-c) is the named graft. Then the Graveyard's gate, the Ballroom's piano and mirrors, the vinery, the six unvaried wings, and the combat balustrade. Work in sheets from the first change.

WHERE YOU STAND. Fix 1 is your round: bring MADDER's authored vantages (ui/r11-vary-c: vantages per region, a proscenium frame, foreground balusters, the wrought-iron gate arch) INTO CAMBER's ROOM_KINDS so every kind in every wing is seen from somewhere of its own -- the gallery from one end of its arcade, the landing from low with the stair rising to one side, the mirror hall from a corner, the plots from among the graves, the gate from under its arch. A vantage is free on the GPU and it is the thing both judges said the rooms still lack. Mind the two traps BRIEF-r11 names: the prop clamp assumes the rig, and a corridor will not take a ballroom's swing. Then fixes 2-4 as they touch your vantages.

THE WINGS NOBODY HAS SEEN. Six wings still have no ROOM_KINDS at all -- Lampworks, Hedge Maze, Secret Passages, Bathhouse, Pumpkin Grounds, the Heart -- so every one of their rooms is one room rearranged, and two of them are judged this round for the first time. Lead with them: two or three kinds each, read straight off their real room names in state/mapgen.js ROOMS (a Steam Room, an Indoor Pool, a Pipe Gallery; a Wax Room, a Reflector Gallery, a Boiler Walk; a Moon Gate and a Glass Pumpkin House; a Whisper Room behind the walls), each a room that wing truly has, each with its own subject compiled into its own wing's MM_ROOMS variant as CAMBER did, so program 0 carries nothing. Then fixes 2-4.
